description: Melusina Water Hair Material Presets — MI_Melusina_WaterHair parameter collections

subtle_drip.description: Gentle water layer, low opacity — for ambient wet-look without over-saturation
subtle_drip.notes: Good for day 1 sprint — dry beauty pass safe

nikki_subtle.description: Lower emissive and more transparent water layer — for Nikki-style beauty lighting without emissive bloom
nikki_subtle.notes: Halved emissive/caustic values for daylight scenes

moderate_splash.description: Balanced water presence on hair with visible drip trails
moderate_splash.notes: Default water hair look — droplets visible but not overpowering

heavy_water.description: Full water coverage on hair with high drip intensity
heavy_water.notes: Use for underwater or heavy-rain scenes only

dry.description: Zero water effect — resets all water parameters to minimum
dry.notes: Fully dry look for beauty stills or dry-environment scenes

magical_glow.description: Low water but high magical intensity for fantasy glow on damp hair
magical_glow.notes: Use during magical ability activation or special sequences

parameter_descriptions.HairDripIntensity: 0.0-1.0 — Overall visibility of water drip on hair strands. Higher = more visible droplets.
parameter_descriptions.SplashForce: 0.0-2.0 — Force applied to water splash particles on hair. Higher = more energetic spray.
parameter_descriptions.WaterOpacity: 0.0-1.0 — Opacity of the water layer on hair. 0 = invisible, 1 = fully opaque water coating.
parameter_descriptions.WaterRoughness: 0.0-1.0 — Surface roughness of water layer. 0 = glossy wet, 1 = matte.
parameter_descriptions.MagicalIntensity: 0.0-1.0 — Emissive magical glow intensity through the water layer.
parameter_descriptions.CausticIntensity: 0.0-1.0 — Caustic light pattern intensity on water surface.
parameter_descriptions.DripSpeed: 0.0-2.0 — Speed of drip sliding animation down hair strands.
parameter_descriptions.DripLength: 0.0-0.5 — Length of individual drip trail segments on hair.
